metadata.query: Why did Dylann Roof kill people in the Charleston church shooting?

reasoning_steps.thought: I need to find out why Dylann Roof killed people in the Charleston church shooting.

final_answer: On June 17, 2015, Dylann Roof killed nine people at the Emanuel African Methodist Episcopal Church in Charleston, South Carolina. Roof's motive for the shooting was reportedly racial hatred and the desire to start a race war. Sources: [1](https://www.cnn.com/2015/06/18/us/charleston-church-shooting/index.html) [2](https://www.nytimes.com/2015/06/18/us/charleston-shooting-south-carolina.html) [3](https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/local/wp/2015/06/18/charleston-shooting-suspect-dylann-roof-charged-with-murder/)
